about_the_game:
Welcome to Valmir!

A new Tactical Collectible Card Game where wit and strategy are the keys to victory. Choose your Faction and build the ultimate deck to crush your enemies.

Combine Combat Skills, empower your units with Items, gain the upper hand with Racial Spells, or dominate the battlefield with Legendary Units. Every match will be unique and unforgettable.

Test your decks in the Training Grounds, uncover each faction’s story in Campaign mode, battle dangerous random foes in Skirmish mode, or challenge other players in Online Multiplayer mode. Each victory earns you resources to unlock new cards, either through Card Packs or by crafting them in the Forge.

Valmir is based on the novel of the same name by Alejandro Ramos Martín. By playing this game, you’ll be immersed in the conflicts between the various factions and discover their stories through rich narrative passages and captivating hand-painted illustrations.

Finally, an indie card game made by card players, for card players!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 o AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB), AMD Radeon RX 5600XT o Intel Arc A750 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i5-10600 o AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (6 GB) o AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
